```{r}
#| include: false
#| warning: false
bugs <- read_bugs_by_component()
old_bugs_now <- count_open_old_bugs(bugs)
old_bugs_closed_7d <- count_old_bugs_closed_since(bugs, Sys.Date() - 7)
by_year <- open_bugs_by_year(bugs)
burndown <- old_bug_burndown(bugs)
cutoff_label <- trimws(format(old_bug_cutoff, "%e %b %Y"))
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste0("Open bugs opened before ", cutoff_label)
list(
  icon = "bug",
  color = "light",
  value = old_bugs_now
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste0("Bugs opened before ", cutoff_label, " closed in the past week")
list(
  icon = "check2-circle",
  color = "success",
  value = old_bugs_closed_7d
)
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=55%}

::: {.card title="Open bugs by component and year opened"}
Bugs with more than one component label are counted once per component, so the
Total column adds up to more than the number of open bugs.

```{r}
#| echo: false
gt_open_bugs_by_year(by_year)
```
:::

### Column {width=45%}

::: {.card title="Burndown of bugs opened before `r cutoff_label`"}
Counted once per component, so the stacked total is higher than the number of
bugs. Uses current labels, so recently relabelled bugs appear under their
current component for all dates.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
plot_old_bug_burndown(burndown)
```
:::
